title: HardFault with INVSTATE after calling callback
serial_logs:
HardFault!
CFSR = 0x00020000  HFSR = 0x40000000
PC   = 0x00000000  LR = 0x08000a3b
MMFAR= 0xE000EDF4  BFAR = 0xE000EDF8
user_question: Happens on first received byte. uart_register_cb() is only called in some build configs.

reference_context.title: Cortex-M4 Devices Generic User Guide (Arm)
reference_context.snippet: INVSTATE (CFSR bit 17): the processor has attempted to execute an instruction that makes illegal use of the EPSR, e.g. a branch to an address with bit[0]=0 so the T bit is cleared.

reference_context.title: Cortex-M4 Devices Generic User Guide (Arm)
reference_context.snippet: FORCED (HFSR bit 30): indicates a forced hard fault, generated by escalation of a fault with configurable priority that cannot be handled.

expected.root_cause: on_rx is still NULL; calling it branches to 0x00000000 with the Thumb bit clear, raising a UsageFault INVSTATE that escalates to HardFault.
expected.fix: Check on_rx != NULL before calling it, or give it a default no-op handler.
